st: Carrie Underwood, 7-Year-Old Raises Money For Hospital, 3 Ways To Use Pantone’s Color of the Year
d: Music superstar Carrie Underwood chats. Meet 7-year-old Hayley Orlinsky who after hearing the frontline workers were running out of PPE decided to sell homemade bracelets to raising more than $27,000. Drew shares 3 ways to use Pantone’s color of the year.

st: Chris O’Donnell, Cooking with Geoffrey Zakarian, Dr. Aliza Pressman
d: "NCIS: Los Angeles" star Chris O’Donnell stops by to chat. Drew’s whipping up a cozy fall soup with accomplished chef Geoffrey Zakarian. Plus, psychologist Dr. Aliza Pressman joins Drew to help solve viewers dilemmas.

st: David Oyelowo, Lonnie Chavis, Cooking with Joanna Garcia Swisher
d: David Oyelowo joins Drew to discuss his feature directorial debut and is joined by co-star Lonnie Chavis. Plus, “Sweet Magnolias” actress Joanna Garcia Swisher chats about her online lifestyle page The Happy Place and whips up Pickled Jalapeno Corn.

st: Isla Fisher & Leslie Mann, Beth Behrs, Drew-Gooder
d: “Blithe Spirit's” Isla Fisher & Leslie Mann chat. ”The Neighborhood's” Beth Behrs joins Drew. Luvvie Ajayi Jones joins Drew to shine the spotlight on another amazing black woman. Meet 10 y.o. Christian Stone who cleared snow off essential workers' cars.

st: “The Talk” Hosts, Chef Pilar Valdes, Benito Skinner aka “Benny Drama"
d: “The Talk” Hosts Sharon Osbourne, Sheryl Underwood, Carrie Ann Inaba, Amanda Kloots, & Elaine Welteroth chat. Pilar Valdes makes a Peppery Steak. Meet America’s youngest hot dog entrepreneur 14 y.o. Mason Wright. TikTok star Benny Drama joins Drew’s News.

st: Zach Braff, Donald Faison, Jamie Kern Lima, Wildflower
d: “Fake Doctors, Real Friends” podcast hosts Zach Braff and Donald Faison. Makeup mogul Jamie Kern Lima on building a billion-dollar business. In “Wildflower,” Drew spotlights women who have paved their own way to success such as mechanic Stephanie Wooster.

st: Actress Kristen Bell, Danny Seo, Drew Gooder: Good Deeds Teacher
d: Danny Seo whips up healthy breakfast recipes and shares ways to utilize your leftovers to help beautify yourself including a strawberry facial mask. Meet the Principal whose school started a grocery store that only accepts good deeds as a form of payment.

st: Sarah Chalke, Roan Curtis, Brunch with Babs, Dear Drew with Heidi Gardner
d: “Eat Wheaties” star Sarah Chalke chats. "Firefly Lane” star Roan Curtis joins Drew and Sarah for Face The Fun Facts. Meet the grandma behind TikTok's Brunch with Babs, Barbara Costello, for breakfast casserole. “SNL's” Heidi Gardner joins “Dear Drew.”

st: Phoebe Robinson, Design Under $30, National Teacher’s Day
d: Podcast host Phoebe Robinson joins Drew to help solve some dilemmas in “Drew’s and Don’ts.”  Comedian Michelle Collins and Drew play “Change My Mind: Reality TV Edition.” Drew celebrates Nat'l Teacher’s Day with Bronx middle school teacher Jamel Holmes.

st: Mayim Bialik, Weird Food Combos With TikTok Chef Eitan Bernath
d: “Call Me Kat” star Mayim Bialik stops by to chat. Plus, designer Melody Ehsani shares her wisdom with small business owners in our minute master class. Then, Drew taste tests some weird food combos with 18-year-old chef and TikTok star Eitan Bernath.

st: Nina Dobrev, Julianne Hough, Drew-Gooder Surprise With David Begnaud
d: Nina Dobrev and Julianne Hough stop by to chat about their new business venture. Plus, “CBS This Morning” Lead National Correspondent David Begnaud helps Drew surprise a deserving Drew-Gooder.

st: Ellie Kemper, Drew Gooder, Ricardo Chavira
d: "The Stand-In" actress Ellie Kemper joins Drew to chat about their new film. Meet Kenya Congress, The Funnel Cake Queen, who uses the money from her funnel cake business to help customers. Plus, "Selena: The Series" star Ricardo Chavira.

st: Taye Diggs, Herb Garden & Cooking with Michael Symon, “The Prom” Star Jo Ellen Pellman
d: “All American” star Taye Diggs joins Drew to chat. Iron Chef Michael Symon teaches Drew how to make a hydroponic indoor herb garden and then shares how to use those home-grown herbs in a vegetable soup. Drew’s News with “The Prom” star Jo Ellen Pellman.

st: Chelsea Clinton, Danny Seo, Drew Gooder: Free Mom Hugs
d: Chelsea Clinton stops by to chat. Danny Seo stops by to whip up sticky toffee baked oatmeal bars and share how to upcycle leftover ingredients into DIY slime. In “Drew Gooder,” meet the mom and son team behind the non-profit organization, Free Mom Hugs.

st: “Drew’s D-Cluttering” Show, Marie Kondo, Rachael Ray
d: It’s “Drew’s D-Cluttering” show! Drew is joined by tidying expert Marie Kondo who shares her tips for sparking joy. Then, Rachael Ray shares kitchen staples for a clutter-less kitchen. Plus, Drew surprises one single mom with a home office makeover.

st: Dr. Phil, "Hubie Halloween" China Anne McClain
d: Dr. Phil shares why it was important for him to produce his new docuseries "That Animal Rescue Show." Then, Halloween week continues with "Hubie Halloween" star China Anne McClain. Plus, Drew’s News with special guest Ross Matthews.

st: Travis Barker, Kelly Marie Tran, Design By Drew: Homeless to Homeowner, Drew’s News
d: Blink-182's Travis Barker chats about his new wellness brand. Kelly Marie Tran joins Drew. In Design By Drew, Drew surprises Chris, who just four years ago was homeless living in his car and now owns a four-bedroom house, with a new nursery for his son.

st: Megan Rapinoe, Emma Corrin & Josh O’connor, #ShareTheMic with Luvvie, Design Under $30
d: Soccer Star Megan Rapinoe and mom Denise stop by. "The Crown" stars Emma Corrin and Josh O’Connor chat. Luvvie Ajayi Jones joins Drew to shine the spotlight on another amazing black woman. Drew shares her own tips to design like a pro all for under $30.

st: Giada De Laurentiis, Chris Appleton, Drew Gooder: Good Deeds Store Follow Up
d: Giada De Laurentiis joins Drew for Cookbook Club and whips up Salmon Puttanesca. Drew revisits with the Principal whose school started a grocery store that only accepts good deeds as a form of payment. Chris Appleton shares his top hair styling tips.

st: Actress Jennifer Love Hewitt, Drew Gooder: Bus Driving Principal
d: Star Jennifer Love Hewitt on growing up in showbiz, her friendship with Betty White and her aha moment with her daughter. Meet the Principal who added the role of bus driver to her duties to ensure all her students had a ride home during the pandemic.
